title: ERW Virtual Field — viewer manifest
description: Describes the grid, variable catalog and file layout for the 3D viewer (viz/). Written by the data pipeline; read by the TypeScript viewer. P6.0 of docs/plans/erw_virtual_field.md.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the pipeline wrote this manifest.

scenario.description: Path to the scenario.yaml used to generate this manifest.

grid.description: Spatial and vertical discretization of the field.

crs.description: CRS as an EPSG string, e.g. 'EPSG:32618' (UTM 18N).

bbox.description: Bounding box in the grid CRS (metres).

cell_size_m.description: Display cell size in metres (model may run at finer resolution).

nx.description: Number of cells in the x direction.

ny.description: Number of cells in the y direction.

depth_layers_m.description: Lower boundary depth (m) of each modelled layer, e.g. [0.05, 0.15, 0.30, 0.60, 1.00].

polygon_file.description: Relative path to field.geojson from the repo root.

forcing_time.description: Time axis for daily forcing variables.

variables.description: Catalog of all variables the viewer may render.

id.description: Snake_case identifier, unique within this manifest.

label.description: Human-readable name for the viewer UI.

kind.description: static = time-invariant field; forcing = daily time series; model = simulation output.

dims.description: Ordered dimension names. E.g. ['y','x'] for static 2D, ['y','x','depth'] for 3D, ['time','y','x'] for forcing.

status.description: available = pipeline has written the data file; pending = planned but not yet computed; missing = no source data.

range.description: Expected [min, max] for colormap scaling. null if unknown.

colormap.description: Suggested colormap name (matplotlib convention). null = viewer default.

source.description: Data source name (must match a row in data/SOURCES.md). null for derived variables.

source_quality.description: dataset = gridded raster; derived = computed from rasters; literature = single value from paper, shown with badge.

uncertainty_ids.description: IDs of Q0.05/Q0.95 companion variables, if any.

file.description: Relative path to the binary data file from viz/data/. null when status != available.
